case_number: 2024 INSC 421; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2567 OF 2024; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 2568 OF 2024
summary: Gang rape conviction appeal; appellate review standard: perversity threshold not met when two acquittals exist; High Court improperly substituted sentence below statutory minimum (3 years vs 10 years); prosecutrix age >16, consent defense viable; Sessions Court findings consistent on consent indicators (no alarm raised, prior relationship); Section 313 CrPC statements showing payment to prosecutrix; evidentiary weight of accused statements discussed; minimum sentence mandate under pre-2013 Section 376(2) IPC.
legal_provisions_cited: Manu Sao v. State of Bihar
Vijendrajit Ayodhya Prasad Goel v. State of Bombay
Ajay Singh v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: State's appeal against lenient sentence allowed; conviction upheld but sentence increased to statutory minimum of 10 years; Vijay's appeal challenging conviction dismissed.
